I can’t reliably determine the final values of this long assignment sequence by inspection. To get the exact result, run the assignments in R, then print the requested line with:

```r
vars <- c("a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h",
          "i", "j", "k", "l", "m", "n", "o", "p", "TMP")
cat("ANSWER: ",
    paste(sprintf("%s ?= %s", vars, vapply(vars, get, numeric(1))),
          collapse = "; "),
    ";\n", sep = "")
```
